---
title: "Atividade 3 - Regressão Linear"
---

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_point, geom_abline, ggsave

X = np.loadtxt("X.txt")
Y = np.loadtxt("Y.txt")

X_mat = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(X)), X))
coef = np.linalg.inv(X_mat.T @ X_mat) @ (X_mat.T @ Y)
a, b = coef[0], coef[1]

df = pd.DataFrame({"x": X, "y": Y})

plot = (
    ggplot(df, aes("x", "y"))
    + geom_point()
    + geom_abline(intercept=a, slope=b)
    + ggsave("grafico_regressao.png")
)

print("Intercepto:", a)
print("Inclinação:", b)
```
